notes.title: Catwifhat v0.8.4 - EASTER EVENT + INFO ABOUT V0.9
notes.content:
Hi, in this update we are adding a new “Easter Box” for you.

The chance to get a box from the drop is 20% and the event will last until 11:59 pm until the end of April 22 (GMT+2).

The next chance to get skins from this box will not be until next year, so hurry ːsteamhappyː

[b]IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT UPCOMING UPDATE V0.9[/b]

In the next update, we will add many new things for you:

- Game music and button sounds
- Change in collections to automatically unlock cats, xp and achievements (the achievement limit for our game is still 100, so we will add the rest later)
- CPS limit to a maximum of 10
- 3 clickers to buy in the itemshop, which will click even when you have the game on in the background
- We fixed stacking and there will be no problem with disappearing items.

We are fixing the last bugs and will add an update soon, and then we will start working on v1.0 in which you will be able to get items for clicking on the cat (each cat will give different items).

We are very excited because this will be the first game on steam that will allow you to get an item by clicking.

Screen showing how v0.9 looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174880/4750b914407c401e2b08fbe308fe61b069e1ce67.png[/img]

notes.title: Catwifhat v0.8 - Rewards + Timer + New features
notes.content:
Hi, it's been a while since the last update, but I hope it was worth to wait because we're adding a lot of new things to the game.

[i][b]FEATURES:[/b][/i]

- When hovering the mouse over a button, the appearance of the mouse changes.
- We reset the clicks, we'll reset them again in “clicking update 2.0”.
- From now on, there is no exit confirmation panel when shutting down the game.
- We've added a gif in the exp counter.

[i][b]TIMER:[/b][/i]

- We've added a timer that counts down to the next drop. Many people didn't understand that the drop is every 3h, so we added it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174880/2da7aff66df9c22317654797e5d180642871e4bd.png[/img]

[i][b]REWARDS:[/b][/i]

- We've added rewards for each level gained in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174880/6041b41b4c4e3ed556c261b56661c23d776f1851.png[/img]

The rewards include items such as Level Box, Lucky Box, Background #4, 1UP Cat, Level 1/5/10 Cat and coins that cannot be sold, but will be useful in future updates to unlock new features in the game including forge and crafting.

Level Box is a new box that can only be obtained from rewards, introduces 18 new skins to the game.

Lucky Box is the box in which all the skins epic and legendary, and the chances of drop are:
95% EPIC / 5% LEGENDARY

If your rewards panel is not working, refresh XP with the button that is next to your LVL!

[i][b]NOTIFICATIONS[/b][/i]

- We've added a window that informs you about refreshed equip and exp.

- We've also added a panel that when you get a drop shows you what you got.

[i][b]COLLECTIONS:[/b][/i]

The collections from now on have padlocks (open and closed)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174880/dc39f72b6a6fe638f72ad9baf8ff38b9e03e306b.png[/img]

Open means you have a cat in your inventory and can unlock it, and closed means you don't have a cat in your inventory.

[i][b]BOXES:[/b][/i]

From now on you can stack and unstack boxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174880/b352544bd0d27f3053a10b69bceea0f99b203496.png[/img]

In the next updates will focus on introducing click drops, forge option and crafting, but that will be announced soon.

notes.title: Future Updates
notes.content:
[h1]Hi, today we want to show you what we plan to add to our game by the end of this year![/h1]

You want more content, so there will be more content!

[h2]Collections:[/h2]
This is our main goal for this year, we want the game to be a game where you can collect unique cat skins, gain xp and get rewards because of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174880/efc8e32c6c0629c3d705f584ba812254d480fa15.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded inventory + item stacking:[/h2]
We know that over time you will have a lot of items in your inventory, so we want to make some room for you in your inventory and add item stacking. We also enable option to remove items and add descriptions to cats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174880/da2acde97ff2e0e81a0a64ec608cacabfeda0ea3.png[/img]
